committed_before_execution: this file is committed to the cycle branch BEFORE any execution of evaluation.frontier_recall_handoff; the git commit time is the freeze evidence, not a hand-written timestamp field
question: The v57 evaluation-lane question charts the RECALL half of the accepted coverage finding to Frontier team frontier-query-concept-recall and orders this lane to publish its numbers BESIDE my own, never in place of them, with any divergence named as the headline. The team has now reached OUTCOME_B_BOUNDED_NEGATIVE and been independently accepted (audit gate PASS, accept commit bd1b4d73a). Does its baseline reproduction (A0) match this lane's own accepted numbers cell-by-cell on the served questions and the frozen multilingual authority-recall cells?
product_decision_unlocked: whether the product's admission self-check question-concept extraction (the one that actually fires the ordered under-coverage disclosure) covers the same concept set as evaluation's mapping-free instrument on the same served bytes; and whether the accepted frontier negative sits on the identical baseline this lane measured. If a divergence exists, Product must know before the human gate; if none exists, the OUTCOME_B negative is directly inheritable by both lanes without reconciliation.

lane_subject_match_audit_accepted.role: THIS LANE'S OWN mapping-free coverage numbers (question_native_concept_coverage gates)

lane_coverage_handoff_latest.role: THIS LANE'S OWN product-side admission self-check numbers (re-executed accepted product code)

lane_retrieval_benchmark_accepted_run_of.role: THIS LANE'S OWN accepted per-language authority-recall numbers (the run of record for the frozen retrieval benchmark)

lane_retrieval_benchmark_charter_cited.role: the replay the Frontier charter cites for the 0/2, 0/5, 0/2 fr-it cells

coverage_per_question: n_bundle_rows: frontier A0 n_rows == lane subject_match_audit n_bundle_rows
under_covered_set: frontier A0 under_covered SET == lane subject_match_audit concepts_with_zero_rows SET == lane product-side measured_query_concepts_under_covered SET
concept_list: frontier A0 concepts == lane subject_match_audit concepts (full ordered list)
product_side_concept_count: lane product-side measured_query_concepts vs lane subject_match_audit concepts - DISCLOSED PRE-OBSERVED cell, see pre_observed_at_design
recall_per_language_cell: for every slug in {corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule, petty-theft-dismissal, rent-default} x lang in {de, fr, it}: frontier A0_baseline_shipped.hits SET == lane accepted-run-of-record authority::baseline_lang_recall::<slug>::<lang> measured.hits SET
for rent-default cells (frozen authority_ids empty): both sides must read measurable=false / passed=null with empty hits
frontier_outcome_copy: the instrument copies the frontier outcome fields verbatim (outcome, improved_fr_it_cells, reduced_under_covered_questions, any_vacuous, n_calls_over_per_search_budget, latency breach text) and verifies only that the audit gate says PASS; it issues no verdict on the candidate

success_rule.exit_0: CONSUMED_NO_DIVERGENCE - every pinned digest matches AND the audit gate is PASS AND every frozen coverage cell and every frozen recall cell matches
success_rule.exit_1: DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE - every pinned digest matches AND the audit gate is PASS AND at least one frozen cell diverges; each divergence is the headline of the record and the report, never smoothed
success_rule.exit_2: ENVIRONMENT - a pinned input is missing or its digest drifts, or the audit gate is absent/not PASS; no cell comparison is read
success_rule.no_weakening: no cell, digest, set-comparison rule or exit mapping may be edited after this file is committed; a moved input is exit 2, never a silent re-pin

pre_observed_at_design.disclosure: the instrument designer, while building this hypothesis, compared the three-way concept table and the under-covered sets, and observed: lane subject_match_audit concepts de=8 fr=9 it=13; frontier A0 concepts de=8 fr=9 it=13; lane product-side self-check concepts de=6 fr=8 it=8; under-covered sets identical on all three sides; n_rows 214/217/211 identical on all three sides. The coverage concept-count cell is therefore a DISCLOSED PRE-OBSERVED cell, tiered as corroborating, not a discovery claim.
pre_observed_at_design.not_pre_observed: the 12 per-language recall hit-list equalities were NOT compared id-by-id before this freeze (only gate pass/fail flags of the lane record were read); the digest integrity of all ten pinned inputs is verified only by the claim-bearing run; the frontier outcome field copy is verified only by the claim-bearing run.

claim_ceiling: verdict vocabulary is CONSUMED_NO_DIVERGENCE / DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE / ENVIRONMENT. This instrument decides ONE thing: whether the accepted frontier baseline-reproduction numbers equal this lane's own accepted numbers on the frozen cells. It does NOT re-score any frozen bar, does NOT adjudicate the frontier candidate, does NOT rebuild or re-dispatch any Frontier charter, does NOT change any packet byte or admission record, does NOT meet any absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bar, does NOT unblock the human gate (both accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand), and authorises no owner question (owner_decision_required stays false).

reuse.no_candidate_built: this lane does not build or re-score any query-expansion candidate; frontier-query-concept-recall is closed (cycle_status COMPLETE, continue_recommended=false) and is consumed read-only
reuse.no_universal_174k: no universal-174k geometry benchmark is run
reuse.mapping_free: no analyst slug, no frozen id set, no baseline record and no mapping of any kind is introduced; the comparison is pure set-equality on the frozen cells above
